provenance.rule: All output remains OCR-derived. A full-receipt observation may join another observation only through exact SKU agreement or close physical-row geometry plus textual agreement. Right-column observations can contribute only price/tax evidence at the same narrow row position. SKU values cannot be imported into rows that lacked a SKU in the selected full-receipt observation. Components with insufficient support are omitted rather than guessed.
